qa_targets: Explicit environment flag exactly 1 enables proof only for session.create; all other settings preserve legacy bytes and calls.
Proof commitment covers the actual serialized HTTP raw bytes and final bearer, scoped client/command/project/null counters and verified Host origin.
Unsupported, malformed, expired or failed proof blocks HTTP with NOT_SENT and no legacy fallback.
Private new Native raw reply rejects unknown and duplicate keys, trailing JSON, wrong host/ref shapes and invalid or expired expiry; existing three public Native actions remain unchanged.
Desktop replay retains original request raw but acquires a fresh proof for each newly selected bearer; proof reference and credentials never enter pending operation, renderer, or logs.
After asynchronous proof acquisition, mutations to request, bearer, identity, origin, resources or command lifetime are rechecked before sending.
A new NOT_SENT refusal cannot clear an already possibly-sent or acknowledged command barrier.
Doctor does not renew credentials, other methods do not request attestation, and request/response public protocol shapes remain unchanged.
Tests must be audited pure mock fixtures with denied real Native, HTTP listener/client, GUI, child process, old database, old credential, model or provider calls.

diagnostics.detail: A design-referenced internal/host/contracts directory is absent in baseline Main. rg reported os error 2; command also read existing public sources and exited 0.
